name: Lunar Earthshine conditional study

original_specification.name: Lunar Earthshine conditional study
original_specification.description: A proposed lighting arrangement for optional Earth illumination investigation.
original_specification.sources: Environment-owned Earth contribution only if geometry and radiance are supplied
original_specification.geometry: Visibility, phase and angular extent are external scene inputs
original_specification.contribution_policy: No default numerical Earth irradiance is invented
original_specification.authoring_method: Original lunar authoring concept. Solar directions and relative contributions are illustrative inputs, not site ephemerides or measured lunar photometry. No atmospheric sky, haze or automatic ambient fill is permitted in physical mode.
validation: Block when Earth visibility or radiance is unspecified
never treat stars as a free ambient dome

scale_policy: Scale light positions/sizes once to an explicitly selected subject; never scale the subject.
limitations: Vacuum mode: no atmospheric sky, fog, star dome or undeclared ambient light.
Solar direction and radiance are authored relative values, not site ephemerides or measured lunar photometry.
unresolved_external_inputs: Earth position, angular extent, phase and radiance are unspecified; Earth source remains disabled, not invented.
